#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    vector<int> odd(n);
    odd[0] = (a[0] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : -1;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        odd[i] = odd[i-1] + ((a[i] % 2 == 1) ? 1 : -1);
    }
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<int>> pq;
    for (int i = 1; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (odd[i] == 0) {
            pq.push(abs(a[i+1] - a[i]));
        }
    }
    int ans = 0;
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        int cost = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        if (b < cost) break;
        b -= cost;
        ++ans;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
